methodology.title: Methodology & sources
methodology.intro: Delulu Dating multiplies independent population filters. It's a Fermi estimate for dating — not a prediction about any individual human.
methodology.b1: Model: independent filters are multiplied (joint probability under independence). A +12% correlation uplift stops “tall + rich” stacks from being astronomically harsher than a naive model.
methodology.b2: Height: HK Population Health Survey (2014/15) reports male mean height 169.5 cm; SD approximated at 5.8 cm from local anthropometric references.
methodology.b3: Income: Census and Statistics Department Annual Earnings and Hours Survey — male wage percentile curve (HK$), interpolated between published points.
methodology.b4: Age / marital / education: 2021 Census and thematic reports (simplified age-window and never-married proxies).
methodology.b5: Districts: 2021 Census district weights blended into male-share priors — illustrative, not block-level GPS accuracy.
methodology.b6: Smoking / kids: broad CHP / survey priors — rounded, not bespoke matchmaking intel.
methodology.outro: This is spicy satire plus public statistics. If you're offended, the numbers still love you. Probably.
